subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ34S across its XF X250 application.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ34S is a single-application engine — fitted to the XF XFR (X250, 2008–2015) — and we work on it regularly.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, complete gasket and seal set, timing chain components where required, supercharger coupler, and oil filter housing gasket as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The AJ34S shares timing chain tensioner issues with other AJ-V8 engines. Supercharger coupler wear can cause rattling noise. Cooling system leaks from pipes, hoses, and connectors are also confirmed.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ34S rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ34S REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ34S's timing chain system is a known critical wear point — we inspect it thoroughly on every rebuild. The supercharger sits on top of the engine and must be removed to access the valley where the oil cooler, timing chain, and other critical components reside.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, complete gasket and seal set, timing chain components where required, supercharger coupler, oil filter housing gasket

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
